editorial:
Imagine waking up in a world where the rules of life and death are flipped upside down. You get dropped into a heavy drama that asks if killing someone else is the only way to keep yourself breathing. The vibe is tense and gritty, focusing on characters who are pushed to their absolute limits. You will feel the stress as the main characters scramble to survive, making choices that will make you question what you would do in their shoes. It is a wild ride that does not let you relax for a second.

The acting is surprisingly strong, and the plot twists keep you guessing until the very end. While the pacing slows down a bit in the middle, the payoff is totally worth it. If you love stories about survival and moral dilemmas, you need to see this. You should definitely try to find a high-quality stream in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best experience. If you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a great move so you can re-watch those shocking moments whenever you want.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the main character realizes the game was rigged from the start. In the final scenes, you see that the only way to truly win is to refuse to play by the killers rules.
